Pilot version 10: what's new
  • New: English Grades 2–6, Terms 1 and 2. All 593 competencies from the official Budget of Work are included, so elementary English now covers all three terms. 416 have ready worksheets (letters and word patterns, theme vocabulary, context clues, prefixes and suffixes, subject-verb agreement, adjectives and adverbs, propaganda techniques, references, reading comprehension). 177 are speaking, writing, viewing or form-filling tasks with task cards and a rubric.
  • Science Grades 3–6, Terms 1 and 2. All 89 competencies from the official Budget of Work now have ready worksheets (Foundation, Core, Extension) and a hands-on activity. Measuring, speed, lever and wave items are generated with computed answers. Science Grades 3–6 now covers all three terms.
  • Science Grades 7–10, all three terms. All 180 competencies from the official Budget of Work have ready worksheets (Foundation, Core, Extension) and a hands-on activity printed on the worksheet and used in the lesson plan. Physics, chemistry and genetics calculations (speed, force, work, energy, momentum, circuits, Punnett squares, atomic structure, concentration) have computed answers.
  • English Grades 7–10, all three terms. All 388 competencies from the official Budget of Work. 340 have ready worksheets (literary analysis, informational texts, facts and opinions, propaganda, evidence, revision and editing, letters), with original short texts inside the questions. 48 writing and publishing competencies have task cards and a 4-point rubric.
  • Mathematics Grades 7–10, all three terms. All 200 competencies from the official Budget of Work have ready worksheets (Foundation, Core, Extension), an exit ticket, an answer key and an ILAW plan. Topics include integers, algebra, linear and quadratic functions, geometry and proofs, trigonometry, statistics, probability and financial math. Use ✏️ to change any question.
  • Science Grades 3–6, Term 3. All 53 Term 3 competencies from the official Budget of Work have ready worksheets (Foundation, Core, Extension) and a hands-on activity that is printed on the worksheet and used in the lesson plan. Weather and volcano items follow the current PAGASA wind signals (Signals 1–5) and PHIVOLCS alert levels.
  • English Grades 2–6, Term 3. All 300 Term 3 competencies from the official Budget of Work are included. 214 have ready worksheets (word study, grammar, vocabulary, figures of speech, reading comprehension with original passages). 86 are speaking, writing or viewing tasks with task cards and a scoring rubric.
  • New: rate and fix any question. On the Worksheets tab, use 👍 (good), 👎 (needs work) or ⚠ (answer is wrong). Use ✏️ to edit the question and answer. Your feedback is saved and can be downloaded for the GuroPrep team.
  • Grades 1–6 Mathematics follow DepEd's official Three-Term Budget of Work. Numbers in math questions can be changed, and the answers update.
  • ILAW lesson plans (DepEd Order No. 016, s. 2026). PDF for short, long or A4 paper. Editable Word file. Answer key as a separate file.
